metadata.title: ngx-logger Ships Bearer Token in Authorization Header with Every Remote Log Request

owasp: A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

transformations: AuthTokenServerService.alterHttpRequest() clones each outbound log HTTP request
Adds Authorization: Bearer <token> to log shipping request headers
sinks: Remote log endpoint (ApplinX /logger) — receives Bearer token with every ERROR-level log message
Log content includes server error messages, host data, screen data passed to logger.error()

privilege_boundary.start_privilege: Log infrastructure attacker or network MITM
privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Bearer token extracted from log request Authorization headers — full session hijack

impact.description: AuthTokenServerService unconditionally injects Bearer token into every ngx-logger remote log HTTP request. If serverLoggingUrl is configured, each ERROR log ships the token. Compromise of log endpoint enables full session replay. CVSS 5.3 MEDIUM confirmed.

remediation.fix_approach: FULLY FIXED: (1) alterHttpRequest() in logger.service.ts returns request unchanged. (2) setCustomHttpHeaders() call removed from StorageService.setConnected() — second injection point identified in integrity audit. Dead getAuthToken() method removed from AuthTokenServerService.

history.note: AuthTokenServerService attaches Bearer token to all ngx-logger remote log HTTP requests — token exposed to log infrastructure
CONFIRMED MEDIUM: Bearer token in every ERROR log request header. Requires serverLoggingUrl configured. Compromise of log endpoint → session hijack. CVSS 5.3 MEDIUM.
PARTIAL FIX: Bearer token header injection removed from alterHttpRequest() in logger.service.ts. Second injection point (storage.service.ts setCustomHttpHeaders) identified but not yet fixed.

COMPLETE FIX: setCustomHttpHeaders() call removed from StorageService.setConnected(); HttpHeaders import removed from storage.service.ts. Dead getAuthToken() removed from AuthTokenServerService. All Bearer token injection paths now closed.
